description:
YITAMOTOR provides you with the best innovative, quality products & professional services at competitive prices. We are confident that our products will surpass your expectations and make you a happy customer!
Fitment
2014-2018 Chevrolet Silverado 1500 Crew Cab
2015-2019 Chevrolet Silverado 2500HD / 3500HD Crew Cab
2014-2018 GMC Sierra / Sierra Denali 1500 Crew Cab
2015-2019 GMC Sierra / Sierra Denali 2500HD / 3500HD Crew Cab
Shifter: No.
Floor Type: Carpet Floor.
Console: Flow-Through Console.
PTO (Power Take Off) Kit: For 2500HD / 3500HD Without PTO Kit.
Does not fit e-Assist models
For your safety, professional installation is highly recommended.
Features
Custom Fit:These floor mats are fit for 2018 2017 2016 2015 2014 Chevy Silverado/GMC Sierra 1500, 2015-2019 Silverado/Sierra 2500 HD/3500 HD Crew Cab, fits flow-through console, and models without shifter, not for vehicles with vinyl floors; 3D laser scanning technology gives full protection to both the front and back, Please remove old floor mats before installing new ones.
Built For Durability: YITAMOTOR floor liners accessories are made from premium TPE material featuring high tensity for great comfort and wear-resistance while remaining flexible and user-friendly even in extreme cold or hot environments; Product contains no latex, cadmium, lead, or any harmful PVC.
All Season Protection & Non-Slip:Uniquely designed channels and raised edge can effectively trap liquid, debris, snow, mud, and sand to keep your car and shoes clean; Built-in retainer clips to firmly grip the mat and prevent slipping when wet.
Easy To Clean:Simply shake the dirt out of the textured skid-resistant surface or spray down with a hose; No vacuuming or harsh chemicals needed for maintenance.
Why Choose YITAMOTOR:Our floor liners are processed with advanced technology, rendering tailored protection and all-weather guard to your vehicle; Our excellent pre- and after-sales services are always available to ensure your purchase is hassle-free.
highlights: They securely attach to your vehicle using the original factory clasps, keeping the floor liners firmly in place and preventing unwanted shifting during daily driving.
The raised edges provide maximum vehicle coverage, Floor Liners accurately and completely line the vehicle carpet giving absolute interior protection.
Specially designed channels ensure the liner effectively contain the liquid to keep your vehicle and shoes clean, non-slip design for safe driving.

specifications.Special features: Solid, easy to install, easy to clean, precision 3d laser measured, perfect fit, waterproof, anti-slip, durable, non-toxic tpe material, all-weather protection
